title: The 22 'unsolved' ADFGVX radio messages, Eastern Front, November 1918 (Childs corpus; Schmeh's list)

steps.what: Made the fourteen published keys machine-readable; repaired three squares damaged by the PDF text layer.
Settled the transposition convention and reproduced page 100 by insertion search over all keys (score 140.7).
Read the 70 comments of the 2017 thread: 9 solved, 3 partial, 10 open; Lasry's sixteenth key found and its square rebuilt (24 of 36 cells).
Norbert's block-edit method reimplemented; re-derives 7 solved pages blind and finds the 22-24 Nov partial.
Two block edits against fifteen keys on the ten open messages; CHI key on the two page-153 messages.
Key-free attack on a planted 224-letter control does not recover the key; open messages (84-240 letters) are below reach.

Outcome split into parts per period key (one key per entry): six keys with their messages (9 solved, 3 partial) and the ten messages no known key fits (not solved), from the NOTES table; README one row per part.

outcome.method_basis: The fourteen period keys published by Lasry, Niebel, Kopal and Wacker for the Childs corpus, plus Lasry's sixteenth (CHI) key from the 2017 Cipherbrain comment thread, were applied with a block-edit search; the only full reading (page 100) had already been read in 2017.
outcome.notes: Nothing read here that the 2017 readers had not read; the thread consolidated and the sixteenth key rebuilt. Ten messages remain open, needing the Childs originals or an unlisted key. Split into outcome.parts per period key on 14 Oct 2026 (one key per entry, parts because the messages form one filed set): 9 solved, 3 partial, 10 open.

parts.label: key of 1-3 Nov 1918 (length 19)
parts.basis: 3 solved, 0 partial, 0 open. Published period key (Lasry, Niebel, Kopal, Wacker 2017); first read in the 2017 thread (p. 100 Armin, pp. 105/109 Norbert); p. 100 reproduced here by insertion search (score 140.7), pp. 105 and 109 re-derived blind by blocks.py.

parts.label: key of 4-6 Nov 1918 (length 17)
parts.basis: 2 solved. Published period key; first read by Norbert in 2017; p. 146 re-derived blind by blocks.py, p. 132 reached by gaps.py on Norbert's text unprompted.

parts.label: key of 7-9 Nov 1918
parts.basis: 1 solved, 2 partial, 0 open. Published period key; p. 171 read by Norbert in 2017 and re-derived blind here; the two p. 164 messages (44 marked gaps each) read in part by Norbert (comments 41-44), not extended here.

parts.label: key of 10-12 Nov 1918
parts.basis: 1 solved. Published period key; read by Norbert in 2017; re-derived blind here with two five-letter block edits (10, 5), (130, 5).

parts.label: CHI key of 13 Nov 1918 (Lasry's sixteenth, length 16)
parts.records: Childs p. 187 (FFVXV; p. 191) and the unnumbered AFAFF continuation
parts.basis: 2 solved. Key recovered by Lasry in the 2017 thread (comment 50) from the two-part message jointly, not on the published list; its square rebuilt here from his plaintext (24 of 36 cells); both parts re-derived blind by blocks.py.

parts.label: key of 22-24 Nov 1918
parts.basis: 0 solved, 1 partial. Published period key; read in part by Norbert (comment 32) and Baertl in 2017; the block search here finds the same partial; 11 marked gaps.

parts.label: no known key fits
parts.basis: 0 solved, 0 partial, 10 open. None of the fifteen keys gives text with up to two block edits (best -6.7 nats per window against -4.4 to -6.0 for the solved pages); the CHI key fails on both p. 153 messages; a key-free attack fails its planted 224-letter control. Needs the Childs originals or an unlisted key.

prior.where: Published keys (Lasry et al.) and the 2017 comment thread under Schmeh's post (9 solved, 3 partial)
